text:
## Learning & Improvement  
**Root Cause Analysis:**
- Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)
- Analyze root cause
- Implement corrective action
- Monitor effectiveness  
**Examples:**
- High "slow processing" complaints → Review SOP, add resources
- Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure
- Fraud complaints → Strengthen security measures

raw_entities.name: Complaints Learning and Improvement Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy framework requiring the bank to identify systemic complaint patterns, analyze root causes, implement corrective actions, and monitor their effectiveness. The policy mandates a structured approach to complaints management that goes beyond individual resolution to drive organizational improvement.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)
Analyze root cause
Implement corrective action
Monitor effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Systemic Complaint Identification Requirement
raw_entities.description: Banks must identify complaints that represent systemic issues — the same problem affecting multiple customers — rather than treating each complaint in isolation. This provision requires pattern recognition across the complaint population.
context: Identify systemic complaints (same issue, multiple customers)

raw_entities.name: Root Cause Analysis Obligation
raw_entities.description: Once systemic complaints are identified, the bank must conduct a root cause analysis to understand the underlying reason for the complaint pattern, not merely the surface symptom.
context: Analyze root cause

raw_entities.name: Corrective Action Implementation Requirement
raw_entities.description: The bank must implement corrective actions in response to identified root causes. This provision mandates that analysis must be followed by concrete remedial steps to address systemic issues.
context: Implement corrective action

raw_entities.name: Corrective Action Effectiveness Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The bank must monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions implemented in response to systemic complaints. This provision requires ongoing evaluation to ensure that remedial measures actually resolve the underlying issue.
context: Monitor effectiveness

raw_entities.name: Slow Processing
raw_entities.description: A complaint category identified in the policy as an example of a systemic issue that may arise from inadequate Standard Operating Procedures or insufficient resource allocation. The policy illustrates that slow processing complaints should trigger SOP review and resource augmentation.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Fee Dispute
raw_entities.description: A complaint category identified as a systemic issue that may result from unclear Terms and Conditions or inadequate fee disclosure. The policy indicates that multiple fee disputes should trigger improved T&C clarity and better customer disclosure.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

raw_entities.name: Fraud
raw_entities.description: A complaint category identified as a systemic issue that may indicate weaknesses in security measures. The policy illustrates that fraud complaints should trigger strengthened security controls.
context: Fraud complaints → Strengthen security measures

raw_entities.name: Standard Operating Procedure Review
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring review of Standard Operating Procedures when systemic complaints (such as slow processing) are identified. This measure ensures that operational processes are evaluated and improved in response to complaint patterns.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Resource Allocation Adjustment
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring the bank to add resources when systemic complaints indicate resource constraints. This measure addresses operational bottlenecks identified through complaint analysis.
context: High 'slow processing' complaints → Review SOP, add resources

raw_entities.name: Terms and Conditions Clarity Enhancement
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring improvement to Terms and Conditions clarity when systemic fee disputes are identified. This measure ensures that customer-facing documentation is enhanced to reduce misunderstandings.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

raw_entities.name: Fee Disclosure Enhancement
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring better disclosure of fees to customers when systemic fee disputes are identified. This measure improves transparency and reduces complaint recurrence.
context: Multiple fee disputes → Improve T&C clarity, better disclosure

raw_entities.name: Security Measures Strengthening
raw_entities.description: A control measure requiring the bank to strengthen security measures when systemic fraud complaints are identified. This measure addresses security vulnerabilities revealed through complaint patterns.
context: Fraud complaints → Strengthen security measures
